# Vendored Three.js runtime

- Version: 0.180.0, matching the locked `three` package version.
- Upstream package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`.
- Runtime files: `three.module.min.js` and its relative dependency `three.core.min.js`.
- The desk and courier scenes import these same-origin files. No CDN access is required to initialize either 3D scene.
